LAW AND MOTION 301, DEFENDANTS ALEX SALDARRIAGA AND HOME HEALTH ADVOCATES, INCORPORATED'S PETITION TO COMPEL ARBITRATION AND STAY COURT PROCEEDINGS IS GRANTED; ARBITRATION IS COMPELLED AND THIS LITIGATION IS STAYED PENDING ARBITRATION. PLAINTIFF'S AGREEMENT INCLUDED THIS DISPUTE, AND THE AGREEMENT CAN ONLY BE READ TO MANDATE COMPLIANCE WITH CALIFORNIA LAW PROHIBITING IMPOSITION OF ARBITRATION COSTS ON PLAINTIFF. THEREFORE, PLAINTIFF HAS AGREED TO ARBITRATE, AND THE AGREEMENT IS NOT SUBSTANTIVELY UNCONSCIONABLE. MOVING PARTY IS TO SUBMIT A PROPOSED FORM OF ORDER. JUDGE: PETER J. BUSCH, REPORTER: CAROL KAREN, CSR # 8189
